svc_about_quote: Every project starts with a conversation — tell me what you need and I'll give you a straight answer.
svc_about_bio_1: I'm a multidisciplinary creator working across music production, translation, and web development. I've been producing music for over a decade, translating technical and creative content since 2019, and building web applications since 2020.
svc_about_bio_2: Based in Eastern Europe (UTC+3). I work with clients remotely in English, Russian, and Mandarin.
svc_mixing_deliverable: Professional mix and master for indie artists, podcasters, and content creators. Stereo stems or full session. Genre-agnostic — hip-hop, ambient, electronic, rock.
svc_music_deliverable: Original beats, ambient soundscapes, full EP/album production from concept to master. Ableton Live, analog processing, vinyl simulation.
svc_music_scope: Single track to full EP (5–7 tracks)
svc_music_timeline: 1–4 weeks per track, 4–8 weeks for an EP
svc_translation_deliverable: Technical documentation, game localization, UI strings, marketing copy. EN→RU (native Russian) and EN→ZH (Mandarin).
svc_web_deliverable: Full-stack SaaS applications, API integrations, rich-text platforms. SvelteKit, Convex, Tailwind CSS, Cloudflare Workers.
svc_web_timeline: 2–6 weeks for an MVP, ongoing for larger projects
